translation: It grows in Guiyang. Gather the bark in the second, seventh, eighth and tenth months and dry in the shade. (With ginseng [人參], Ophiopogon [麥門冬], licorice [甘草], rhubarb [大黃] and Scutellaria [黃芩] it harmonizes the center and boosts qi; with Bupleurum [柴胡], purple quartz [紫石英] and dried Rehmannia [乾地黃] it treats vomiting and counterflow.
